visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a green and white checkered shirt stands in a brightly lit, colorful studio set. He speaks expressively to the camera while holding two blue circular signs with the white character '東'. (2) The camera switches to a medium shot showing the man laughing and introducing another man standing beside him, who is also holding signs. (3) The scene shifts to the man standing next to a metal clothing rack filled with black and transparent travel storage bags. He gestures toward the items with his hands. (4) Detailed close-up shots show the man demonstrating a black multi-compartment hanging organizer. He points out internal pockets and zippers while explaining its functionality. (5) He removes the organizer from the rack and skillfully folds it into a compact black rectangular carrying case to show its portability. (6) The man holds up a large transparent vacuum-sealed bag containing a black puffer jacket, while a woman in a yellow top assists him by holding the top of the bag. (7) A humorous discovery inside the bag leads to a moment of intense laughter among the presenter and guests on set. (8) The final scene is a group shot on the studio stage with approximately ten people smiling and waving at the camera as social media overlays appear.
